title: ABCD: Shipping Issue / Missing Item
text:
Action: Pull up Account
Action: Validate Purchase
Ask how long they have been waiting
sometimes the package is mistakenly marked as delivered

title: ABCD: Troubleshoot Site / Invalid Credit Card
text:
Instruct the customer to try entering their credit card information again
Instruct the customer to log out of their account and log back in.
Have the customer check the expiration date
Start by asking for the customer’s credit card number

title: ABCD: Account Access / Recover Username
text:
Action: Pull up Account
Action: Verify Identity
You make up their username

title: ABCD: Product Defect / Return Due to Color
text:
Action: Pull up Account
Action: Validate Purchase
Confirm their order can be returned, by checking their membership level.
If the customer can return, tell them the good news and go to the next step
Since the customer will print out a shipping label for the return, you need their full address.
Options include: 'By Mail', 'In Store', or 'Drop off Center'
If the customer cannot return, apologize and explain the problem. Then [End Conversation]
